data.summary: Finanzamt Neu-Musterdorf amended your 2022 income tax assessment on 17 December 2024 after your employer sent changed information. The tax stays at €6,918.00, so there is no additional payment and no refund.
data.explanation: The tax office corrected your 2022 income tax notice (Einkommensteuerbescheid) because your employer reported changed data. The result is the same as before: €6,918.00, so nothing to pay and nothing to be refunded. You don't have to do anything if you agree. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch) against this notice. The app shows the deadline for it. Keep the letter with your tax records. A tax adviser can help if you are unsure.
